pill.desc: white and blue-green opaque hard capsule

tell: A thalidomide analogue with a 4-hour half-life, eliminated primarily by the kidneys.

clues.text: A high-fat meal lowers exposure by about 20%, but it can be taken with or without food. About 30% binds plasma proteins, and elimination is primarily renal.
Molecular weight 259.26. It is more soluble in organic solvents and low pH solutions.
Approved under an NDA as 2.5 to 25 mg capsules, given once daily.

Boxed warning for embryo-fetal toxicity, hematologic toxicity and venous and arterial thromboembolism. Contraindicated in pregnancy and in severe hypersensitivity; thrombocytopenia and neutropenia are common.
Multiple myeloma with dexamethasone, or as maintenance after stem cell transplant; transfusion-dependent anemia from 5q-deletion myelodysplastic syndromes; and relapsed mantle cell lymphoma.
Binds cereblon, a component of an E3 ubiquitin ligase complex, so that substrate proteins are degraded, with direct cytotoxic and immunomodulatory effects.
The generic name begins with L and has twelve letters.
